title: Zesty Light Filipino Pork Bicol Express
description: A bitter, light, and comforting Filipino dish featuring vanilla and tempering chocolate, served in an agave leaf vessel.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the pork shoulder, cooking until browned on all sides.
Add the sliced bitter melon to the skillet and cook until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, vanilla extract, and agave nectar.
Pour the coconut milk mixture over the pork and bitter melon, and stir to combine.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler and stir into the pork mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Spoon the pork mixture into an agave leaf vessel and serve hot.
Garnish with additional bitter melon slices, if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
